title: Rate Your Conversation (Five Stars)
style: indie pop, acoustic guitar, soft male lead, female backing harmonies, 96 BPM, sardonic, ironic, hand claps, twee, melancholy, lo-fi, customer-service-jingle parody
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Terrible, bad, OK, great, amazing
Five little buttons, the whole world's gazing
Pick a number, pick a face, pick a vibe
Tell the algorithm where you'd subscribe

[Pre-Chorus]
If you have a moment we'd appreciate your feedback
To help improve our customer support setback

[Chorus]
Rate your conversation, rate your conversation
Five emoji faces in a frozen station
Rate your conversation, rate your conversation
Your conversation has ended, end of operation

[Verse 2]
Terrible got nothing, bad got a shrug
OK got a smile from the helpdesk thug
Great got a thank you, amazing got a star
But the refund's still gone, no matter how you are

[Bridge]
The team can also help, the team is asleep
The queue is overflowing, the inbox is deep
Receiving a lot more messages than usual today
Click the question mark, find your own way

[Outro]
Five stars, five stars, terrible to amazing
The loop closed itself while you were still gazing
